_comment: ICT Form 3 Teacher’s Guide, first typeset 2026-11-23 from "ICT Form 3 - Teachers Book - V9 - FINAL - Ready for Typesetting 23 Nov REVISED.docx".

Subject spelled "Information and Communications Technology" as on the manuscript title and as the ICT Form 3 LB sets it (theme default reads Communication), so cover, title page and running header agree across the pair.
authors: the publisher line under the author on the manuscript title page was picked up as a second author; the guide has one author.
Topic 3.4 restarts Learning Activity / Exercise numbers at Specific Competence 3.4.1.2, as the LB does: left as written.

End of Topic answer guides: each sat in a one-column Word frame (now unwrapped by the engine). Their titles and the "Marking guide: Section A/B" lines are set as heads, so none is left at a page foot apart from its table.

image9 (Figure TG 3.1.6, site map): the white margin round the drawing trimmed (ICT Form 3 TG-art/site-map-trimmed.png) so the last lines of Topic 3.1 do not run onto a page of their own before Topic 3.2.

boxAllRows: the activity and exercise boxes are one-column Word tables whose later rows hold the model-answer tables and figures (Table TG 3.1.1 ... Figure TG 3.4.4); without it only each box’s first row printed and 25 of them were missing.
subtext: nine Expected responses items typed with no space after the number ("2.The organisation’s name"), unlike the rest of their lists.
image7 (Figure TG 3.1.4, page sketch) a little narrower so it stays in Learning Activity 4 under the line that introduces it instead of leaving half of page 17 empty.
